notes.title: Roger's Route DLC Devlog (08/18/24)

[h1]Lay it on us, phone-papa:[/h1]

I'm actually [b]at the final stages of development now[/b], doing tiny bits of pick-up assetwork (namely for stuff like props in Gingi's hands + transition screens), audio work and of course: [b][i]programming the physical route! [/i][/b]In the last 2 weeks, I've completed about 25% of the total route programming (or 50% of Roger's evil route!)

This mightn't sound like much, but keep in mind, the total wordcount of the route is 94-96k words, and I even added 2 new scenes to the route [b](both of which have had scripts + assets completed and are being programmed on this very day!)[/b] It's been a busy, busy last few weeks!

[i]As a treat, here's some footage showing off some [b]voice acting + Peter's theme![/b][/i]

[previewyoutube=oZHaga_MlPQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Originally, I was gonna push to get the route out at the end of the month, but given that a few of my collaborators ended up with having more on their plates IRL than planned, I think it'd be safer to aim for [i][b]late September to early October! [/b][/i](So, during the Mingus campaign, which'll be featured in my NEXT devlog!) Based on total progress over the last few weeks, I'm actually completely on track to hit that target!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/9958e2f802393a032bf76afc6c5ded7e6c80cfea.png[/img]

Obviously this is the largest route Dialtown has, in its wordcount, the number of unique tracks, the number of endings and more and I'm doing my best to make it the best it can be before it releases. I wanna thank you guys again for your patience. Rest assured - [b]no rest shall be assured for me until this is out! [/b]Thanks, everyone!

notes.title: Roger's Route Devlog - Release Month Announcement + Joe Teaser Video!
notes.content:
Hey, Dialtownies! It's time for a devlog where I discuss Roger's route some more! The next devlog after this one'll [i]likely[/i] be the announcement for the Norm plush (which I've just received the prototype for!)
[h1]So, how's the DLC comin' along, Dogman?[/h1]
Some pretty major strides have been made, actually! The biggest and most important change to discuss since the last devlog is actually in how much new content has been added to the route. Roger's route has grown [i]massively[/i] since I started working on it. Most notably, many new scenes have been added featuring appearances from [i][b]practically everyone[/b][/i] in Dialtown's cast! By my count, including characters who physically appear on screen during drawn segments or have full dialogue scenes, I think there's about [i][b]17 cameos![/b][/i] There's also references to characters who [i]DON'T[/i] appear! So, very few characters have been left out!

Here's a new cameo scene from the start of the route, featuring a character that was previously unmet (but that many of you likely know!)

[previewyoutube=XIATEmzgNTE;full][/previewyoutube]
Joe isn't the only 'special' cameo in the route, by the way ;)

I can also announce that [b]6 out of the 8[/b] route ending slides have been completed now! Some of you might be surprised to learn that [b]2 NEW [/b]endings have been added since my last devlog! A lot of new assets for the route have been completed (including new character sprites, with the route even having a few [i][b]brand new characters!)[/b][/i] Lemme whip out the chart so I can quickly quantify what's done:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/a5caccea0fa4e1d31ce9ad771f053933a4b803f5.png[/img]
The little bit in green is implemented and ready to play in-game right now. What's in orange has a more or less finalized script, formatted + ready to enter into the engine! What's in white isn't entirely incomplete either! [b]These scenes have been story-boarded and I'm currently writing and finalizing a script for these segments right now![/b]

The wordcount for the green + orange bits is about [i][b]68,000 words[/b][/i]! For comparison, Norm's whole route is about 42k, and Oliver's is only about 24k! The route also has a [b]record number of endings[/b], with Karen + Randy's routes tied for second place, with only [i]6[/i] each! So, this is already shaping up to be the largest Dialtown route by far! There's quite a lot of [b]branching dialogue[/b], [i][b]tons [/b][/i]of cameos, a new art sequence with voice acting is in the works (and yes, some of the new voice acting is recorded for the route, with two fan-favourite characters getting brand new lines!)

Since it's been so long since you guys have had a truly meaty DT content release, I'm going all out for this route, treating it like an [b]expansion to the base-game[/b]! You guys have been really great to me and honestly, Dialtown's success has really changed my life, so I'm trying my hardest to deliver a route that'll entertain, satisfy and hopefully make a lot of you really happy! There's even nods to my older work + fandom in-jokes in the route and some scenes were drafted specifically using feedback I've gotten from the base game's content (aka, what you guys want more of!) Because the route has grown much larger in size (with lots of new art, voice acting, tons of scenes), the [b]price-tag of the route will probably be $5![/b]

[b]I'm aiming to have the DLC out in July! [/b]No idea on the exact date yet. Presuming nothing catches on fire, I should be able to meet the date, given how much is done.

[h1]Show us the haps, Dogman:[/h1]
Over the last couple of months, I've been working on assets (backgrounds, character sprites), and implementing the [b]very first scenes[/b] in the route, with finalized assets! I've also moved further ahead with the script. [i]There's [b]new voice lines[/b] too! [/i]Oh, and there's also been [b]new ending slides[/b] finished behind the scenes as well. [i]Funky![/i]

Since I'm quite a bit behind my targeted release date, thanks to having to move in December, I thought I'd show off a few minutes of footage from Roger's route, [strike]partly to show that I'm still working on it[/strike], featuring the redux of Roger + Peter's introduction scene in Dialtown, complete with new assets, fonts and plenty of new dialogue! Work on the route has been slow (but steady) lately!

[previewyoutube=Utcwh6hNVyA;full](INSERT VIDEO HERE, DON'T FORGET, DOGMAN, SO HELP ME GOD)[/previewyoutube]

Yep! There's gonna be more merch dropping for Dialtown's 2-year anniversary (which is on the 14th of February)! Specifically, a [b][i]Phonegingi plush[/i][/b] and a trio of [i][b]Dialtown enamel pins[/b][/i], which even come with new Dialtown art. [i][b]Wowzers![/b][/i]

I'll resist showing them off JUST yet, but the Makeship pages for each'll be going live the day after this goes up, and a few days after that, I'll be begin teasing the new designs on my [url=https://twitter.com/DirectDoggo]Twitter[/url]/[url=https://www.tumblr.com/blog/directdogman]Tumblr[/url] accounts! Thanks for reading and for y'alls patience waiting for the new DLC! I'm doing my [i]very[/i] best to make sure that the wait's worth it! [i]Thanks!!![/i]

notes.title: OFFICIAL KAREN PLUSH - LIMITED EDITION + ROGER DLC!!!
notes.content:
Alright, two big announcements, one related to the game being updated and one relating to merch! Apologies, I genuinely forgot to update this place for the last few big bits of news, but it's something I'll make an effort to remember to do during big news reveals! Anyway, I'll start with the more recent news and work backwards (and try to include lots of pictures to break up the text!)

[h1]New limited edition Karen Dunn plush available now:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/c9de7bd117e222f3c12d76e8a26b42464fe92cee.png[/img]
[url=https://www.makeship.com/products/karen-dunn-plush]Yep, there's an official Dialtown Karen Dunn plush, available right now on Makeship.com![/url] I'm extremely happy with how her design turned out (especially the accuracy of the stitched horse decal.) I've had her prototype for a couple of months now and I've been extremely excited to show off her design to you all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/ebb90ba7e7dc6d32b1a216330b8366674fb3010a.png[/img]
She also makes quite a pairing with the Randy + Oliver plushies! Together, they form a pretty powerful coalition of plushies. Honestly, I feel a bit of an aura coming off the three of 'em. Bit of an presence, alright. Perhaps even a slightly malevolent one? [i]Beats me.[/i] Anyway, here's a few pics of the trio (assembled, as they belong:)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/d962c63022abc1350f10d6f79123d1bf63f91fe7.png[/img]
Of the three Dialtown plushies that exist as of me writing this, I'm the most pleased with how Karen's design translated into plush form! As you can see from the pics, the manufacture quality is just as top-notch as with the other two. [i]If[/i] the DT plushies continue selling well, I have plans to expand into more characters, like [b]Gingi [/b]+ [b]Norm [/b](and perhaps beyond it?) [b]Think of the limitless possibilities. [/b]Anyway, one last image of the trio, this time with crime scene/mugshot photo lighting:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/6ac9bf7a2c009bccbbfd6f6cb3420a6a4e45a3e3.png[/img]
It's like they robbed a [b]bank.[/b] [i]What a world.[/i] But, also what's [i]this?[/i] Well, I felt bad for not giving Oliver quite as much attention as I did with Randy during [i]his[/i] campaign, so I decided to film a skit trailer for Karen, featuring my [i]new face mask![/i] I wanted something that was kind of hard to look at and [i]ho boy[/i] did I snag a beaut.

[previewyoutube=0T_ZJV4l5no;full][/previewyoutube]
Okay, I feel like I might need to explain myself a little. Yes, I totally could've probably commissioned something better from a fursuit designer, but... I feel like if I own even [i]PART[/i] of a fursuit, my soul is basically [b]forfeit.[/b] This mask suits the vibe of my work better anyway, in the sense that it's extremely off-putting and hard to look away from (without feeling like something hungry is staring into you), buuut also fairly inexpensive. [i](Bonus!)[/i] I spent only [i]$30[/i] on this thing. 

[h3]Alright, that's it! This Karen plush is limited edition, like the last couple, meaning she'll only be available for a few weeks! [url=https://www.makeship.com/products/karen-dunn-plush][u][b]Store page is right here![/b][/u][/url] Now, onto the next bit of news![/h3]

[h1]BEHOLD, DLC: Roger's route[/h1]

Yep! You probably saw this if you follow me on [url=https://twitter.com/DirectDoggo]Twitter[/url] [i](I know, I know)[/i], [url=https://www.tumblr.com/blog/directdogman]Tumblr[/url] or [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC4uA5CGmGFHCnoeThurvuew]Youtube[/url], but I figured I'd make a crosspost here for the few that missed the other posts: [i]YES[/i], there's gonna be a [i]new DLC[/i] for Dialtown coming before the end of this year! 

...and it's about [b]Roger.[/b] I've got a few minutes of early footage from it, featuring a few new tracks on the OST, including Roger's own theme!

[previewyoutube=_d6i4fM1hUE;full][/previewyoutube]
In this route, you can visit Roger's workplace and assist Peter in the arduous task of somehow figuring out how to help Roger save his dying factory (or, y'know, you can just scam Roger yourself and try to earn more than the pitiful $5 Peter offered you with [b]croime.[/b]) The DLC will cost a couple of dollars when it drops later this year (month yet to be announced!) and will feature 6 endings, making the DLC a full DT route, on par with, say, Randy or Karen's route!

And naturally, if Roger's route gets good reception, [i]I may just follow it with more DLC![/i] If you've a hankering for more playable Dialtown content, then you'll be on the pig's back before this year's out! [i](That's good!)[/i] As the video also shows, yes, there's going to be more voice acted content (and new art too!) The response to DT has been staggering (for instance, Dialtown has hit over 1k positive reviews on Steam! Hell yeah!), so I wanna make sure the next nugget of Dialtown content's a genuinely good time and the best I can make it! :) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/eed67ad7d02f3ba8968341ae147464d433120e00.png[/img]
The video speaks for itself, really, but I will also remember to show more off when I get closer to release! I'm juggling quite a bit right now, so it'll still be a few months before I can finish this off, I reckon! Either way, figured I'd quickly note it here since I forgot to before. Thanks for reading and for your continued support, everyone! I'll update y'all again when there's more news! Thanks!!!

notes.title: DIALTOWN DEVLOG (12/09/21)
notes.content:
[h3][i][b]Howdy, folks, it's been a while, huh?[/b][/i][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/90c75785a6f5f197c0ceef1102319172a0ae1451.png[/img]

First of all, sorry for the wait, I'm aware it's been a couple of months. This is honestly a weird point in development because at this point, every new scene I have, even still images, contain [i]spoilers.[/i] This makes it hard to show what I'm actually working on [i]off.[/i] But, I've been hard at work! Progress has been going well, and I'm excited to show you a few things :) Gonna make this a [i]BIG [/i]devlog because you guys deserve it!

[i][b][h1]Meet Mayor Mingus! [/h1][/b][/i]
[previewyoutube=Xidl0UHoYFs;full][/previewyoutube]

Been a whiiile since I revealed a new character, so I thought I'd introduce everyone to Mayor Mingus Crown, Dialtown's corrupt and ruthless leader. This lil scene is from one of the routes. (Also, thanks to my cat Salvage for modeling for her! It's the head. It's HIS head.)

[h1][i][b]Demo is playable on Android phones![/b][/i][/h1]
Yeah, yeah, I know, I know. I had an older build on mobile previously. But, the new build has fullscreen support, NEW ui with bigger buttons, bugfixes + more touch friendly controls, etc! A lot of work went into it, it's STILL experimental... 

[h3][url=https://gamejolt.com/games/Dialtown/495033]But if you wanna try it out, you can get the demo on mobile [i]RIIIGHT over here![/i][/url][/h3]

Getting the full game on the google playstore would also [i](hopefully)[/i] allow Chromebooks to play Dialtown, since that can access the Play Store! Woohoo. [b]I also updated the PC version with some shared code improvements[/b], namely to UI. It's ALSO [b][i]super experimental,[/i][/b] so lemme know how it all works!

[h1][b]Total progress:[/b][/h1]
[i]Alright, drum-roll please...[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/92773672fed267055413d3f0ccd6c1669f55e890.png[/img]
Yep! Progress has been good! While the jump from the last devlog mightn't look all that impressive, believe me, a lot of work has gone into the next scenes, so really, that yellow should be a light shade of green. They're (mostly) asset complete, but a decent bit of work is needed to complete them. If you've played the demo and seen the standards I set for the early routes, you'll understand why. Things [i]do [/i]get picked up a notch.

Then, I have to finish the extras menu, and then really teesssssstttt the whole game out, lots of bugfixing, tweaking and testing. But, it's doable. A few of my developer friends said they're willing to give me a hand when the time comes. :)

[i][b]I'm still on track for a 2021 release![/b][/i] Only reason I'd delay it is a release conflict or if a massive IRL calamity hit me. I have a realistic release date in my head that I'm aiming for. If all goes well, next devlog'll confirm what that date is! Otherwise, that's it for this devlog. I wanna thank you all for dreaming and hooting and hollering with me and such, and of course, for reading this devlog. [i]Hope y'all are doin' well![/i]

[h2][i][b]Stay Houndly!

-Dogman[/b][/i][/h2]

[i][b]But, progress has been good![/b][/i]

[h1]1k demo players! (and a comment on Dialtown's overall public process.)[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/939a20fdcf0943d5db77374eb87db5df86262611.png[/img]
Well, I'll keep this short, but over 1,000 people have played (and I hope enjoyed) Dialtown's demo! This is a really weird number for me, because you can look at it in two ways. In a cynical light: DT's demo only made in two months what Dayshift at Freddy's (my last series) makes in 2.5 days! 

That's... [i]not so encouraging.[/i] In a way, just a teensy bit heartbreaking, actually, as is the fact that only ONE youtuber that's covered DSaF has actually bothered to play Dialtown's demo, with most not even acknowledging my messages at all. (Which I believe to be a major reason for these poorer figures.)

What [i]IS[/i] encouraging, though, is the outpouring of fanart, the active discord community appearing for the game, as well as the dedication of the fans that Dialtown DOES have. Phonecord, for instance, Dialtown's discord server [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/SMEDN7M][i][b](CLICK THIS TEXT IF YOU'D LIKE TO JOIN.)[/b][/i][/url] has over 400 members and is incredibly active. 

Usually, when a big release happens, there's a jolt... followed by a decline, until something big carries the release to a larger base of people. Dialtown's player numbers have remained [b][i]CONSISTENT[/i][/b], despite only minor updates occurring to the demo, which is an incredibly optimistic showing of just how much its fans are trying to [strike]force the game down people's throats like a regurgitating momma bird [/strike]help convert potential players to the Dialtown family, which is fantastic to see.

That truly gives me the motivation to finish the game, knowing that not everyone is going to walk away just because I don't do FNaF stuff anymore. Really.
